title: 接雨水
description: 单位宽度柱子的高度给定，求下雨后可积存的总水量。

class Solution:
    def trap(self, height):
        a = height
        n = len(height)
        b = [0] * 20000
        d = [0] * 20000
        e = [0] * 20000
        ans = l = lm = r = rm = 0
        l = 0
        r = n - 1
        lm = 0
        rm = 0
        ans = 0
        while l <= r:
            if lm <= rm:
                lm = mx(lm, a[l])
                ans = (ans + lm) - a[l]
                l = l + 1
            else:
                rm = mx(rm, a[r])
                ans = (ans + rm) - a[r]
                r = r - 1
        return ans
